// Known divergences between cpp-itanium and c++filt.
//
// Clone-suffix symbols (.cold, .part, .isra, .constprop, etc.):
// c++filt appends "[clone .suffix]" to the demangled name, but our
// scheme passes ilt.NoClones (because Options.DisplayThunks defaults
// to false), which strips those suffixes. The base demangling is
// otherwise identical. Consumers that need clone annotations should
// pass Options{DisplayThunks: true}.
_ZN3foo5innerEv.cold.1
_ZN3foo5innerEv.part.0

// Sugar-vs-expansion: ianlancetaylor/demangle uses Itanium ABI
// abbreviations (St → std::, Ss → std::string, So → std::ostream) and
// emits the short forms. GNU c++filt expands those to the full
// template instantiations. Both representations are correct; ours is
// more compact.
_ZlsRSoRKSs

// Template-closing-bracket spacing: ianlancetaylor emits GNU-style "X<A, B >"
// (space before ">") whereas llvm-cxxfilt emits C++11-style "X<A, B>".
// Only affects the LLVM secondary oracle; GNU c++filt agrees with us.
_ZSt4endlIcSt11char_traitsIcEERSt13basic_ostreamIT_T0_ES6_
_ZSt7forwardIRKNSt6vectorIiSaIiEEEEOT_RNSt16remove_referenceIS4_E4typeE
_ZNSt3__16vectorIiNS_9allocatorIiEEE9push_backERKi
_ZN3std6vectorIiSaIiEEixEm

// llvm-cxxfilt does not decode lambda-encoding (UlXE) or Java-ABI
// symbols with J-prefix return types. These are valid Itanium and our
// scheme decodes them correctly per GNU c++filt.
_ZN3foo3barEUlvE_
_ZN3foo3barEUlvE0_
_ZN4java4lang4Math4acosEJdd
